help.title: Help & Support
help.subtitle: Get started with FeedSolve and find answers to common questions
help.getting_started_desc: Log in to your FeedSolve account and start creating feedback boards. Each tier comes with a specific number of boards and submission limits to help you manage your feedback effectively.
help.managing_subscription_desc: You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your subscription at any time from your billing dashboard. Changes take effect immediately for upgrades, or at the end of your billing cycle for downgrades.
help.features_by_plan_desc: Different plans unlock different features. Visit our pricing page to see a detailed comparison of all features available in each plan, and upgrade anytime to access premium features.
help.usage_limits_desc: Monitor your usage in the dashboard. Each plan has monthly submission limits and team member restrictions. The dashboard shows your current usage and how much quota remains.
help.team_management_desc: Invite team members to collaborate on feedback collection and responses. Each plan allows a specific number of team members. Team members can be assigned different roles and permissions.
help.custom_branding_desc: Available in Growth and Pro plans, customize your feedback forms with your brand colors and logo to maintain consistency with your website and branding guidelines.
help.tip_reply_1: Go to Templates from the main navigation.
help.tip_reply_2: Click Create Template, give it a title and the message body.
help.tip_reply_3: Use placeholders like {{customer_name}} for personalized replies.
help.tip_reply_4: When replying to a submission, click Insert Template and pick your saved template.
help.tip_reply_5: Edit before sending if you need to tweak the message for the specific submission.
help.tip_reply_hint: Tip: Keep templates short and ask one question at a time — it speeds up resolution.
help.tip_escalation_2: Click New Rule and choose a trigger (e.g. status is received for more than 24 hours).
help.tip_escalation_3: Set the action: notify a teammate, change priority, or reassign the submission.
help.tip_escalation_4: Save and toggle the rule on. The system will check rules automatically.
help.tip_escalation_hint: Tip: Start with one rule for critical priority and tune from there to avoid alert fatigue.
help.tip_merge_1: In the Submissions list, open the duplicate submission you want to merge.
help.tip_merge_2: Click Merge and select the primary submission to merge into.
help.tip_merge_3: Confirm — the merged submission stays linked to the primary one and is hidden by default.
help.tip_merge_4: Toggle Show merged at the top of the list to review merged items later.
help.tip_merge_hint: Tip: Merge only after you've confirmed the topic and reporter intent match — merges aren't easily reversible.
help.tip_location_qr: How to use Location-tagged QR Codes
help.tip_location_1: Open your board's settings and add the locations you operate (e.g. "Lobby", "Drive-through").
help.tip_location_2: Go to the QR codes section and download a QR per location.
help.tip_location_3: Display the QR at that physical location — incoming submissions are automatically tagged with the location.
help.tip_location_4: Filter the Analytics → Submissions by Location chart to compare locations.
help.tip_analytics: How to read the Analytics report
help.tip_analytics_1: Pick a date range using the selector at the top of Analytics.
help.tip_analytics_2: Use the Report Builder on the Full Analytics tab to choose which sections to include.
help.tip_analytics_3: Click Generate Custom Report to download a tailored PDF with only the sections you ticked.
help.tip_analytics_4: Use Export CSV to get the raw submission list for pivot-table analysis.
help.tip_invite_2: Enter their email and pick a role (Owner, Admin, Manager, or Viewer).
help.tip_invite_3: The invitee receives an email link to join your workspace.
help.tip_invite_4: Change roles or remove access at any time from the Team page.
help.tip_track: How to track a submission as a customer
help.tip_track_1: After submitting feedback, customers receive a unique tracking code.
help.tip_track_2: Direct them to the /track page or share the link with the code prefilled.
help.tip_track_3: Customers can see status updates and your public reply.
help.support_desc: Need assistance with your subscription, features, or have questions about your plan? Our dedicated support team is here to help you succeed with FeedSolve.
help.email_support_desc: Email us with any questions about billing, subscription management, features, or general inquiries. Our team typically responds within 24 hours.
help.faq_upgrade_q: Can I upgrade or downgrade anytime?
help.faq_upgrade_a: Yes! Upgrades take effect immediately, and downgrades take effect at the end of your billing cycle.
help.faq_payment_q: What payment methods do you accept?
help.faq_payment_a: We accept all major credit cards through Stripe's secure payment processing.
help.faq_limits_q: What happens when I exceed my plan limits?
help.faq_limits_a: You'll receive notifications when approaching your limits. You can upgrade your plan anytime to increase your submission quota.
help.faq_export_a: Growth and Pro plans offer CSV export for advanced analytics. Contact us for enterprise data export solutions.
